ask: Add my LinkedIn posts from last week to the Spring launch campaign.
before: Today is Wed Nov 11; last week is Mon Nov 2 to Sun Nov 8 in the workspace clock.

steps.why: Find the campaign by name. Two with that name: ask which. Attaching works whatever its status, finished ones too.
Last week's LinkedIn posts. Show them (#, day, first line) so the user sees exactly what will be added; add only what they confirm.

post_ids alone, with campaign_id and no other campaign field. Up to 100 ids a call. Partial results are normal: already_present means it was in the campaign, not_found means not this brand's. Report what attached. Attaching writes, schedules and publishes nothing and doesn't start the campaign.
Read back: the three now show among its posts.

say: Added 3 LinkedIn posts from last week to Acme's Spring launch campaign. Their results now count toward it.
never: Adding posts the user didn't see listed.
Saying a post can be removed here: removing one is done from the calendar's campaign picker in Bolta.
Starting a campaign because posts were added to it.
